_comment: Cooking model (Steve 2026-10-08): cooking is digestibility, not a multiplier. Every food has GROSS kcal (chemical energy). Net = gross x digestibility(state). Raw digests worse + carries disease risk; cooked digests better, capped at gross — energy is never created. Classes are per food-kind; monster meat carries weird diseases that cooking does NOT cure.

fruit.blurb: Eat them raw. Fire only wastes the sugar.

grain_legume.blurb: Must be cooked. Raw is a gamble with your gut.

greens.blurb: Barely worth the fire — but they wilt down nicely.

meat.blurb: Fire kills the parasites and loosens the protein. Worth the fuel.

monster.blurb: Cooking helps. It does not make it safe. Nothing makes it safe.

mushroom.blurb: Fire settles the questionable ones. Mostly.

tuber.blurb: Raw starch is barely food. Fire unlocks it — the biggest gain at the fire.

monsterDiseases.down: At night you howl without deciding to — wanderers hear it (+detection after dark).
monsterDiseases.expire: The ache fades. Your throat is your own again.
monsterDiseases.name: Howlbelly
monsterDiseases.onset: Your belly aches low and strange. At dusk you throw your head back and HOWL — long and ragged. You didn't decide to. Nobody decided that.
monsterDiseases.up: Small monsters hear what's in your gut and think twice (fear check).

monsterDiseases.down: Rage fits: in a fight you may lash out at whoever's nearest — friend or foe.
monsterDiseases.expire: Your shoulders drop. The world stops insulting you.
monsterDiseases.name: Gristlefit
monsterDiseases.onset: Your shoulders bunch up around your ears. Your hands keep making fists. Everything is an insult.
monsterDiseases.up: +25% strike damage while the fit lasts.

monsterDiseases.down: Audible digestion — your gut ribbits at the worst moments (-stealth).
monsterDiseases.expire: One last ribbit, small and sad. Gone.
monsterDiseases.name: Croakbelly
monsterDiseases.onset: Your stomach swells like a war drum. Then, from inside you: RIBBIT.
monsterDiseases.up: Choir toads hear kin in your gut. They won't start anything.

monsterDiseases.down: Food moves slow through armor (-25% kcal absorbed; digestion clanks, -stealth).
monsterDiseases.expire: The armor passes. Loudly. You don't look back.
monsterDiseases.name: Shellgut
monsterDiseases.onset: Your gut feels... armored. When it digests, it CLANKS.
monsterDiseases.up: Nothing ingested can touch you — poison and food-borne disease slide off.

monsterDiseases.down: Your tears run black — people decide you're possessed (-trust).
monsterDiseases.expire: Your tears run clear again. People stop edging away.
monsterDiseases.name: Witness Maw
monsterDiseases.onset: Your eyes water black — thick, shining. The dark gets... detailed.
monsterDiseases.up: Night is half as dark to you.

monsterDiseases.down: You quack when startled — surprise is impossible (+wanderer detection).
monsterDiseases.expire: The urge to follow fades. You walk like yourself again. Probably.
monsterDiseases.name: Flockmind
monsterDiseases.onset: You feel a powerful urge to walk in a straight line behind whoever's ahead. Also: QUACK.
monsterDiseases.up: Duck-lines recognize flock. They won't start anything.
